prompt:
Create a high-fidelity desktop application UI mockup for DigUp, a LOCAL private media search and People gallery. Composition B of three: "Calendar rail". Straight-on entire flat app window, landscape 16:10, crisp 4K, no device frame or perspective. The attached current DigUp screenshot is ONLY a reference for native sans readability and dark graphite/amber familiarity. REPLACE its crowded chrome and stacked index rows. Do not repeat its identical astronaut photo fixtures.
Pinned visual world: spacious professional dark graphite, restrained warm orange for selected/active state, neutral muted grey counters, Windows native sans text, thin dividers and 8–12px rounded controls. Dark flat quiet surfaces, no decorative glow, no oversized headings.
Exact regional structure:
Top 64px: DigUp at left, very wide search box "Поиск по смыслу, имени или содержимому", clear X within it, settings gear at right.
Second 48px navigation row: "Поиск", "Граф", "Люди" (active amber underline). Right "Поиск по лицу" outline button.
Main left 230px: people directory, "Найти человека" search, plain rows with small photo crops and sample labels "Анна", "Семья", "Друзья", selected Анна muted warm tint; bottom "+ Создать метку".
Main gallery right: Анна heading, quiet "128 файлов", rename action; single-line tabs "Галерея", "Разметка", "Предложения 6", "Исключённые", "Требуют проверки".
SIGNATURE DIFFERENCE: Below tabs a broad but slim year timeline, height90px across gallery width. It has short subtle grey ticks at 1998,1999,2000,2001,2002,2003,2004,2005. A thin warm orange range covers 2000 through 2003 with two unambiguous handles. Caption left "Период: 2000 — 2003"; two small precise editable year fields or labels "С 2000" / "По 2003" on right plus "Сбросить". Under the rail muted hint "Дата съёмки · иначе дата файла". This timeline has no fake histograms/statistical bars, only years and selected interval.
Then one compact gallery row: segmented chips "Все", "Фото", "Видео" (Фото active), result text "24 фотографии", sort "Сначала старые" aligned right.
Gallery content: four columns and two visible rows of varied fictional archival family/outdoor holiday photographs, whole uncropped photos with neutral dark mat as necessary, each with filename and muted date under it; selected period all years2000–2003 and only photos because Фото is selected. Some dates annotated "Дата файла" to show fallback. Avoid card nesting, gradients and ornamental buttons.
Bottom SINGLE compact32px status footer: "Индекс обновлён", "Новых предложений: 6", short real-looking progress slot "Лица: 18 / 42", "Подробнее" at far right. No tall technical banners elsewhere.
Subtle caption "Макет · демонстрационные данные". All UI Russian, legible. Gallery remains the visual focus, timeline is useful working control not decorative chart. This variant lets the user sweep a range of years quickly and adjust precise ends.
